title: Probably Approximately Correct Maximum A Posteriori Inference
abstract: arXiv:2601.16083v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Computing the conditional mode of a distribution, better known as the maximum a posteriori (MAP) assignment, is a fundamental task in probabilistic inference. However, MAP is generally intractable, and remains hard even under many common structural constraints and approximation schemes. We take a novel approach inspired by multi-armed bandits, recasting MAP as a best arm identification task. We introduce probably approximately correct (PAC) algorithms for MAP that provide provably optimal solutions in both the fixed-confidence and fixed-budget regimes. We characterize tractability conditions using information theoretic measures that can be estimated from finite samples. Our PAC-MAP solvers are efficiently implemented using probabilistic circuits and graphical models with appropriate architectures. translated_title: 概率近似正确的最大后验推断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.16083v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：计算分布的条件众数，即最大后验（MAP）赋值，是概率推断中的基本任务。然而，MAP通常是难解的，并且在许多常见结构约束和近似方案下仍然困难。我们采取了一种受多臂老虎机启发的新方法，将MAP重新构建为最佳臂识别任务。我们引入了用于MAP的概率近似正确（PAC）算法，在固定置信度和固定预算设置下提供可证明的最优解。我们使用可从有限样本估计的信息论度量来刻画可解性条件。我们的PAC-MAP求解器通过概率电路和具有适当架构的图模型高效实现。我们开发的算法既可以作为独立的MAP估计器，也可以用于改进标准启发式方法，增强其求解能力。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多臂老虎机思想的新型概率近似正确（PAC）算法，将最大后验推断转化为最佳臂识别问题，在固定置信度和固定预算下提供可证明的最优解，并利用概率电路和图模型高效实现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes novel probably approximately correct (PAC) algorithms inspired by multi-armed bandits, recasting maximum a posteriori inference as best arm identification, providing provably optimal solutions in fixed-confidence and fixed-budget regimes, efficiently implemented via probabilistic circuits and graphical models.
